notes: כִּי takes the ASV's *if* under rule 55, no other conjunction standing in the clause to compete for it.
לִפְנֵי fused to *before* headed on the construct noun (rules 23, 30), and כַּאֲשֶׁר fused to *as* headed on its opening morpheme (rule 23).
הַמִּצְוָה הַזֹּאת: the single written determiner is the *this* of the demonstrative pronoun, so both articles are `unrepresented` (rule 41).
